title: Scheduled mechanism reachability register
description: T6 M3 batch 5. One entry per scheduled mechanism that runs a repository script (a GitHub Actions workflow step with an `on.schedule` trigger), plus non-repository scheduled mechanisms recorded as verifiable: false. Checked against .github/workflows/*.yml by scripts/check-scheduled-reachability.mjs (npm run scheduled:check). No entry here changes what any workflow does.

workflow.description: Path under .github/workflows/ to the workflow file this mechanism lives in.

trigger.description: The only trigger kind this register tracks. A mechanism whose workflow has no cron schedule fails MECHANISM_NOT_SCHEDULED.

runs.description: Repository path of the script this step invokes, resolved from the step's working directory (e.g. a `cd apps/api && npx tsx scripts/x.ts` step resolves to apps/api/scripts/x.ts).

secrets.description: Map of environment-variable name to secret name, read from the step's `env` and the job's `env` (step wins on a name collision), e.g. { "NOTION_API_KEY": "NOTION_TOKEN" }. Empty object if the step reads no secret. A map, not a list, so renaming the variable while keeping the secret is a MECHANISM_SECRET_MISMATCH -- the check compares both the variable name and the secret name.

verifiable.description: This mechanism's schedule cannot be mechanically verified from this repository (e.g. a Railway cron service configured outside Git).

evidence.description: Repository paths documenting the mechanism by hand, since no workflow file proves it.

match.description: How to locate the step within the workflow: by its `id:`, by its `name:`, or (when a step has neither) by a substring of its `run:` command.
